name: Midou Kokonotouka
source:
“A new school means new encounters. I hope you find someone wonderful too, Kazuhito.”

The accomplished student council president of Tsukuyomi Academy.

A candidate to inherit the Midou Group, the conglomerate responsible for redeveloping Advent City, she possesses exceptional natural talent. She treats everyone with kindness and is admired throughout the school.

However, her perfection often makes her seem unapproachable.

Class: Dreamer
Reality-Altering Ability: Cloud Walker — an ability that grants control over local gravity. Beyond its use for movement, the ability can also be used offensively by imbuing bullets with reality-altering properties.
